ios.desc:
A modern, web first, privacy-focused news reader.

Wire is entirely focused on aggregating RSS feeds and rendering articles in a modern way. Articles are downloaded for offline use, but you read them in a real browser. Most RSS readers only show you the content in the RSS feed, but Wire gives you the original article.

Feeds are synced across devices using iCloud and your Apple ID, so you don't need an additional user account.
